arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT card_id) AS cards_with_same_timestamp_pair FROM (SELECT card_id, date FROM transactions GROUP BY card_id, date HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) AS dup
arguments.explanation: Counts the cards that have at least one pair of transactions sharing the exact same timestamp.
assumptions: 'Exactly the same timestamp' means identical date values to the second, across all transactions regardless of amount sign, error status or fraud label.
Transactions with no fraud label are included, since the question does not restrict to labelled rows.
